summary: Evergy Kansas Central, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for an offering of senior secured First Mortgage Bonds. The filing leaves pricing blanks: aggregate principal amount, coupon, maturity and series are unspecified, with a price-to-public table showing only percentage placeholders. Bonds are secured by the mortgage, rank equal to existing mortgage debt, are structurally subordinated to subsidiary debt, pay semi-annual interest, and carry an optional tax-credit-event redemption at 101%. Joint book-running managers are PNC Capital Markets, RBC Capital Markets, Truist Securities and US Bancorp. This is a routine debt capital raise, not a special situation.
